title: Mailbox/set: create+update in same request can both claim the same role
description: Create loop checks all_mailboxes + created.values(). Update loop checks all_mailboxes + roles_updated_this_request. Neither cross-checks the other: a create that assigns role X followed by an update that assigns role X in the same request both succeed, producing two mailboxes with the same role. RFC 8621 requires role uniqueness.
